requirements.requirement: The system must render a side-by-side layout displaying at least two providers simultaneously.
The system must display each provider's name and identifying information at the top of each comparison column.
The system must display an overall score for each provider in a visually prominent position.
The system must render a breakdown of individual evaluation measures for each provider aligned row-wise across all providers.
The system must visually highlight the highest-performing provider per measure using a distinct indicator (e.g., color or icon).
The system must visually indicate lower-performing providers per measure using a distinct but non-misleading indicator.
The system must support rendering more than two providers without layout breakage or overlap.
The system must use a consistent reusable React component structure aligned with existing component patterns in the codebase.
The system must accept input data conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-COMPARE-UX-S1 without requiring transformation inside the component.
The system must correctly render normalized scores and rankings produced by EVAL-COMPARE-UX-S2 without recomputing them.
The system must maintain column alignment across providers for all measures even when measure labels vary in length.
The system must render gracefully when a provider is missing one or more measures by displaying a placeholder state.
The system must render a fallback empty state when fewer than two providers are supplied.
The system must remain visually readable and usable across standard screen sizes (desktop and tablet) without horizontal overflow breaking layout.
